message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through the attic for our old camping gear. While I didn't find much, I did uncover my go-bag from a few years back. I was pleasantly surprised to see that I had packed some snacks and a flashlight—perfect for our upcoming family hike! It felt like a small win, knowing I was a bit more prepared for our adventure. Sometimes, those little moments of readiness can turn an ordinary day into something special. What small preparations have you stumbled upon lately?
